releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.50 — the chat header grew the tools WhatsApp puts there. Search the open conversation with the magnifier: matches highlight in purple, and tapping one jumps the timeline to that bubble, which is briefly ringed. Long-press a message and choose Select to tick several — the header turns into a count with Forward, Copy, Select all and Delete (delete for me or for everyone). Star a message and it keeps a small star next to its time and appears under ⋮ → Starred messages, with its text saved so it survives the sender deleting the original. Half-written messages are now remembered per chat and shown as a red Draft on the chat row. Opening a photo gives you the whole chat's photos: swipe sideways, pinch to zoom, double-tap to fit.
